features.name: Session Creation & Initialization
features.lifecycle: App mounts -> generates session UUID -> loads config/theme -> initializes REPL state -> displays LogoV2 banner
features.filesystem_req: Write access to config and session directories
features.gap: None (Certified in Parity Gate)
features.migration_strategy: Maintain current TS shell session bootstrap and synchronize session ID over UDS to Rust SessionManager.

features.name: Resume Past Session (/resume)
features.lifecycle: User triggers /resume -> reads project session logs -> presents interactive LogSelector -> user selects turn -> recovers messages and cost state -> mounts REPL
features.filesystem_req: Read access to session storage files
features.brain_equivalent: crates/brain-storage SQLite event log and session repository
features.gap: Resume UI reads legacy JSONL session logs; Brain SQLite session event log is not yet unified into LogSelector source list.
features.migration_strategy: Adapt `utils/sessionStorage.ts` to query Brain SQLite sessions via UDS adapter in addition to filesystem JSONL files.

features.name: Token Streaming & Typewriter Drain
features.lifecycle: Query executes -> receives stream events -> buffers in TypewriterQueue -> renders incremental text deltas -> autoscrolls VirtualMessageList
features.persistence_req: Append assistant turns to session transcript
features.brain_equivalent: crates/brain-services UDS monotonic StreamEvent chunks via brainCallModel.ts
features.gap: None (Certified in Parity Gate)
features.migration_strategy: Preserve generic `QueryDeps.callModel` seam streaming monotonic events from Brain UDS daemon.

features.name: Reasoning & Thinking Blocks (ThinkingConfig)
features.lifecycle: Receives `thinking` stream events -> renders collapsible ThinkingBlock with elapsed timer -> captures signature -> collapses on text_delta start
features.persistence_req: Store thinking blocks in message history DTO
features.gap: None (Certified in Parity Gate)
features.migration_strategy: Preserve native reasoning chunk streaming without fabricating synthetic signatures.

features.name: Structured Diff Rendering
features.lifecycle: Computes file patch delta -> tokenizes line changes -> highlights intra-line word diffs -> renders unified or side-by-side box with red/green backgrounds
features.gap: None (Certified in Parity Gate)

features.name: Response Interruption & Cancellation (Ctrl+C / Escape)
features.lifecycle: User presses cancel key -> CancelRequestHandler triggers AbortController.abort() -> query loop halts -> appends InterruptedByUser notice -> resets composer
features.gap: None
features.migration_strategy: Preserve AbortController wire propagation to Brain UDS cancellation endpoint.

features.name: Multiline Input (`\` + `Enter`)

features.name: Push-to-Talk Voice Streaming (/voice)

features.name: Theme Selection & Live Diff Preview (/theme)

features.gap: None (Certified in Parity Gate)

features.name: Model Selection Dialog (/model, Alt+P)

features.name: Architect / Plan Mode (/plan)

features.filesystem_req: Write access to project plan directory
features.gap: None
features.migration_strategy: Reuse frozen Plan mode toolchain and markdown plan persistence.

features.name: Session Memory Periodic Extraction
features.lifecycle: Post-sampling hook triggers -> checks token thresholds -> spawns forked subagent via `runForkedAgent` -> updates conversation notes markdown file
features.persistence_req: Writes conversation notes to session memory path
features.filesystem_req: Write access to session memory directory
features.gap: Claude writes markdown notes files; Brain manages structured entities and relations in SQLite database.
features.migration_strategy: Bridge session memory extractions into Rust `brain-storage` entity repository.

features.name: Auto Dream Background Memory Consolidation
features.lifecycle: Background timer detects idle state -> acquires lockfile `consolidationLock.ts` -> runs forked agent -> consolidates long-term user preferences
features.filesystem_req: Write access to consolidation lockfile and memory store
features.gap: Claude uses file locks and LLM prompt consolidation; Brain uses transactional SQLite WAL and domain aggregate methods.
features.migration_strategy: Delegate background consolidation to Rust domain engine.

features.name: Context Compaction & Token Summarization
features.lifecycle: Message tokens cross limit -> microcompactMessages runs -> LLM generates condensation summary -> collapses prior turns -> clears pre-compact file cache
features.persistence_req: Overwrites active session transcript with compacted turn
features.gap: Claude summarizes in-memory turn list; Brain persists compacted snapshot in SQLite WAL log.
features.migration_strategy: Delegate session compaction directly to Rust `SessionContext::compact`.
